title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions.
